summary: Anthropic announced a partnership with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) to deploy Claude to 50,000 TCS employees, build Claude-powered products for regulated-industry clients, and join the Claude Partner Network.

mechanisms.reason: Large-scale enterprise deployment across tens of thousands of employees and tens of millions of end customers implies increased aggregate Claude usage, though no compute figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: TCS will provide Claude to 50,000 of its own employees across 56 countries

mechanisms.reason: TCS is packaging Claude into task-specific offerings like claims processing and lending advisory and using Claude Code for engineering and IT operations, shifting some work from humans to AI-driven tools.
mechanisms.quote: TCS will package Claude into industry-specific offerings, such as claims processing for insurers and lending advisory for banks
